summary: Project to manage scoring setup using a Callaway Chart Editor, including promoting edited draft chart values to become the default scoring table.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add ability to copy edited values from the Callaway Chart Editor (draft) into the default table and set them as the new default values.
Update the code-based default Callaway grid chart values so they match the edited values currently in the Callaway Chart Editor draft, and use those values as the new shipped defaults.
Update the default-values documentation to reflect that the shipped defaults now match the draft editor’s edited chart values, and remind how localStorage can mask code default changes.
